turns.user_input: Load the expense data from data/expenses.csv and give me basic stats: total spend, average per category, and top spenders by employee.

Run anomaly detection on this data. Look for statistical outliers within each category, duplicate submissions, suspicious patterns like weekend purchases, round-number spikes, and category mismatches.
I see you flagged some entries from John Smith on weekends. Those are actually fine - he regularly works weekends and travels on Sundays for Monday meetings. Remove those from the anomaly list.
What about the duplicate entries? Show me the exact pairs that look like duplicate submissions with their IDs, amounts, and descriptions.
Calculate the total dollar amount of all confirmed anomalies (excluding the John Smith weekend entries we cleared).
Generate a formal anomaly report I can send to the finance team. Include a summary, categorized findings, recommended actions, and the total financial exposure.
